explanation: Each held about 6 grams of gold plated over silver, plus a hexagon of iron taken from the Eiffel Tower. The last Olympic gold medals of solid gold were awarded in 1912.

claims.text: The Paris 2024 Olympic gold medals were made mostly of silver, with about 6 grams of gold plating.
Each Paris 2024 medal included a hexagonal piece of original iron from the Eiffel Tower.
The 1912 Stockholm Olympics were the last to award gold medals made of solid gold.
